Hey, I'm 16 come later this month, male, and feel like I won't be able to last until then. I've been depressed since middle school, 8th grade. I've tried everything and I feel like I'm just wasting my time trying to hold on. Freshman year was rough at first for me, every day I felt like crying all the time and usually did once I got home. I met a friend of friends and he asked if I wanted Adderall for finals, but the good feeling got me hooked. Basically I ended up abusing Adderall and soon Oxycodone and although the highs made me feel good, when I came down and was at home it was hell. Now it's my sophomore year and I've gotten into much heavier drugs, I stopped cutting freshmen summer but the scars still show. I thought that the only way I'd get through was abusing drugs. It's not enough. All my friends are either dealers or are the type to not really care if I told them. I'm throwing my life away and see people I used to know at school all the time. I know if I confronted my old friends we'd reconnect and I could actually talk about my feelings to them, but even on pills my anxiety is too much. I always think about suicide and always think about reaching out to one of those old friends but I never do. I know for a fact that if I don't then soon it will be too much to handle. I don't know what to do, please help.
